scope: static, full diff read file by file (Leonida Launcher.bat, LAUNCHER.md, DESIGN.md, art.py, kit.py, toolbox.py, launcher.pyw, OFL.txt); binary assets (2 TTF fonts, icon.ico, icon.png) noted but not analyzed; nothing executed
findings: No malicious code found. All download URLs are hardcoded constants (python.org, aka.ms, sdk.lunarg.com, github:git-for-windows release resolver, gyan.dev); no user input reaches a URL

Installers only run after an Authenticode check: status Valid AND exact match of the parsed O= DN component against the expected publisher; the file is held open with no write/delete sharing between check and launch, closing the swap race; fail-closed when no signer is set
ffmpeg zip gated on a pinned SHA-256, deleted on mismatch; unzip_tool explicitly rejects zip-slip paths

Updates are git pull --ff-only against a constant URL, --autostash behind explicit confirmation, automatic mode restricted to a clean main tracking origin/main; subprocess calls are fixed argument lists, no arbitrary command execution
NOTE (correctness): REPO_URL still points to the old ItsNotRexed/Leonida location instead of the ProjectLeonida org; a fresh ZIP-copy connect pins the stale URL as the git remote permanently

NOTE (hardening): the bundled binaries (two Big Shoulders TTFs, icon.ico, icon.png) ship with no integrity provenance (no committed hash/size); fonts are a recurring malware vector, a small SHA-256 manifest would let reviewers confirm the unmodified OFL build
Could not be commented on the PR itself: Leonida interactions are currently restricted to collaborators
